title: Líder Técnico Salesforce
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Líder Técnico Salesforce


Buscamos um Líder Técnico Salesforce para atuar como referência dentro da empresa, garantindo a excelência técnica da plataforma e apoiando o time de negócios na tradução de requisitos em soluções escaláveis e eficientes. Esse profissional será responsável por transformar histórias de negócios em escopo técnico, apoiar a gestão do backlog e assegurar a performance, segurança e governança do ambiente Salesforce.


Principais Responsabilidades

Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce, orientando o time e apoiando na tomada de decisão estratégica.

Refinar histórias de negócio, transformando em histórias técnicas e requisitos claros para implementação.

Apoiar o PM na escrita e detalhamento das histórias de usuário.

Administrar as orgs Salesforce, incluindo controle de usuários, permissões, configurações e integrações.

Gerenciar storage, capacidade e performance do ambiente Salesforce.

Garantir boas práticas de segurança, governança e compliance dentro da plataforma.

Apoiar iniciativas de integração com outras tecnologias.

Atuar próximo das áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções técnicas robustas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida em Administração e Configuração Salesforce.

Conhecimento em Salesforce Service Cloud, Sales Cloud e integrações via API.

Habilidade para refinar histórias de usuário em backlog técnico.

Vivência em gestão de capacidade, storage e performance de Salesforce.

Experiência como ponto de referência técnica em projetos Salesforce.

Proatividade, visão crítica e capacidade de liderar discussões técnicas.


Requisitos Desejáveis

Desejável o conhecimento em desenvolvimento .NET.

Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder ou similares).

Experiência com DevOps Salesforce (CI/CD, Git, ferramentas de versionamento).


CLT

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico.


Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

• Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.

• Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must

• Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices

• Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:

o Geneos ITRS

o EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)

o Market Data API

o AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment
  • Regular team events
  • Long-term career prospects

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer (LATAM)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico.


Company Description

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Our Client

Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. It specializes in advising on mergers, acquisitions, and capital-raising activities for major corporations and governments. Known for its strong presence in global financial markets, the firm provides market-making and trading services across various asset classes. It has earned a reputation for shaping the financial landscape on Wall Street and beyond. The organization is also committed to philanthropy and sustainability through its various initiatives and programs.


Role Description

We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience

• Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .

• Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.g. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.

• Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python.

• Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.

• Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must

• Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices

• Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:

o Geneos ITRS

o EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela)

o Market Data API

o AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company
  • Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences
  • Continuous development and training opportunities
  • A competitive salary package with additional social benefits
  • Interesting and challenging tasks
  • The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job


We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.


What is CORNER Renovation?


CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.


Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.


Requirements:

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent/Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray 
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max/Corona is a plus


Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.
  • Develop kitchen and other space designs based on details collected from clients.
  • Conduct online meetings with new and existing clients to understand their requirements.
  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.
  • Provide guidance on efficient kitchen layouts, including the selection of storage solutions.
  • Review technical drawings and orders before production.
  • Assist in selecting appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
  • Communicate with the internal team to ensure alignment across project details, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project, ensuring clear communication, smooth process, and an excellent client experience.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Professional growth and experience working with international clients
  • Flexible vacation and holiday schedule
  • Company covers 50% of course costs


Looking to work for a fast-growing startup with great career opportunities? We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are ready to work hard, and eager to learn and develop their skills.

After you apply, we will review your application. If it meets our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the details and schedule an interview.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Description

With 18 years of experience in technology, DEVELL has delved into the field of Generative Artificial Intelligence since its inception, positioning itself as a significant player in a market full of endless possibilities. Our deep understanding and practical application of Generative AI make us the ideal partner for companies looking to explore and maximize the potential of this revolutionary technology. At DEVELL, we convert emerging opportunities into tangible solutions that drive innovation and growth.


Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.


This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.


Responsibilities

  • ⁠Architect, design, and implement scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain back-end services with NestJS.
  • Contribute to front-end development using at least two frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, or Vue.
  • ⁠Design modular and abstract solutions that reduce complexity and improve maintainability across projects.
  • ⁠Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI, product, design, and infrastructure) to deliver robust solutions.
  • Review code, mentor peers, and promote best practices in software engineering.
  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.


Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Mandatory: Proven experience with NestJS.
  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).
  • Experience building and maintaining complex, scalable systems.
  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.
  • A mindset for clean code, testing, and maintainability.


Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.
  • Experience with AI-powered applications.
  • Experience managing internal packages using private registries (npm, Verdaccio, GitLab, etc.).
  • ⁠Hands-on experience with bundlers (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Nx).

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Full-Stack Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full-Stack Sênior para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. Procuramos um profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações web e forte domínio em Java e suas principais tecnologias.


O candidato ideal é alguém que já tenha atuado em projetos complexos, seja capaz de propor soluções escaláveis e tenha uma postura proativa na resolução de problemas.


Atividades a Serem Exercidas:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web e mobile, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e segurança.
  • Implementação de soluções back-end utilizando Java, JavaScript e Node.js.
  • Desenvolvimento de interfaces front-end com HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular e React.
  • Gerenciamento e otimização de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, assegurando integridade e performance.
  • Controle de versão e colaboração em projetos utilizando Git (branches, merges, rebase, cherry-pick, pull requests, Git flow) e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub e GitLab).
  • Aplicação de metodologias ágeis para melhorar o fluxo de trabalho e a entrega contínua de software.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Back-end: Java, JavaScript, Node.js.
  • Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React.
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL.
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab).

Conhecimentos Técnicos e Certificações Desejáveis

  • Certificações:
  • Oracle Certified Professional Java SE Programmer (versão 8 ou superior).
  • Oracle Certified Professional Java EE 8 Programmer.

Conhecimentos adicionais desejáveis:

  • Experiência com infraestrutura em cloud computing para otimização e escalabilidade.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento mobile para Android e iOS.
  • Implementação de recursos de segurança em aplicações.

title: FBS Sr Finance Analyst
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premium well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

Location: Brazil/Mexico – Working Hours: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (PST)


What You’ll Do:

You’ll develop the IT annual budget and obtains sign-off by budget owners; prepare IT cost allocations to the business units for IT services and any assigned financial reports; monitor expenditures for assigned services, ensuring compliance with corporate policies; identify ways to automate processes, increasing efficiency and accuracy; review financial implications of new system initiatives and prepares financial analysis reports in support of new projects.


Experience:

  • 5 years of experience.


Skills:

  • Proficiency in English (The interview’ll be in English)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
  • Accounting – Intermediate
  • Forecasting – Intermediate
  • Management Presentation - Entry Level
  • SAP - Intermediate
  • Excel - Advanced


  • Competitive compensation and benefits package:
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Performance Bonus


Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

title: SDR ESTAGIÁRIO
description:
ESTAGIÁRIO SDR - VOANDO COM GV AGÊNCIA DE VIAGENS


Pré-requisitos:


  • Estar matriculado(a) e frequentando regularmente uma instituição de ensino superior;
  • Morar em Uberlândia ou região;
  • Ser bom/boa comunicador(a);
  • Ter facilidade em conversar por ligação;
  • Ter escrita semântica e ortograficamente correta;
  • Digitar com rapidez.


Responsabilidades principais:


  • Qualificação: fazer o primeiro contato com leads/cliente via plataforma de mensagens gerando um diagnóstico sobre a qualificação de cada um para o departamento de Vendas;
  • Prospecção inbound: recontatar clientes da base para criar oportunidades de revenda ou prospectar indicações de leads com o perfil ideal;
  • Remarketing: recontatar leads reprovados para recuperar a atenção e refazer a qualificação.


Benefícios:


  • Bolsa-auxílio de R$ 800,00;
  • Trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar;
  • Bonificação por atingimento de metas;
  • Treinamentos pessoais e profissionais.


Tipo de contrato:


  • Estágio (Lei nº 11.788/2008);
  • Regime de trabalho Home Office;
  • Jornada de trabalho: segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 19h.


✨ É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da equipe da agência mais bem avaliada do Google no Triângulo Mineiro, que tem revolucionado a forma como as pessoas viajam na região e em todo o Brasil!
company: Voando com GV Agência de Viagens

title: Bolsista Doutor - BCS SISTEMAS - Estimular o uso do smartphone no dia a dia no comércio varejista | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. title: Calypso Back Office Business Analyst
description:
Why Join Qaracter


Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do


  • Support and configure Calypso back office modules (settlements, payments, accounting)
  • Assist with Calypso platform upgrades and system workflows
  • Maintain SDI data and ensure operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with global teams to address technical queries



What You Bring


  • 8+ years in financial services with 3+ years using Calypso
  • Strong Calypso back office experience
  • Solid understanding of MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Computer Science, or Engineering
  • Strong problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments



Location


  • LATAM (Remote).



Your Benefits at Qaracter


  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.
  • Well-being program and team events.
  • Competitive compensation and top-tier equipment provision.



At QARACTER Group, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and non-discrimination in all our processes, promoting an inclusive and diverse work environment. All applications are welcome regardless of sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, age, disability, or any other personal or social condition, in line with our Plan de Igualdad and our commitment to equity.

title: Agente de Retenção – Chat
description:
Descrição do Cargo

O Agente de Retenção – Chat é responsável pelo atendimento receptivo de clientes que solicitam a exclusão de suas contas na plataforma. Esse profissional atua com foco em retenção, buscando compreender os motivos da solicitação, oferecer soluções alternativas e incentivar a permanência do cliente. Quando a exclusão for mantida, o agente deve garantir que o processo seja conduzido com clareza, agilidade e respeito, assegurando uma experiência positiva até o encerramento da relação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

● Atender clientes via chat de forma receptiva, compreendendo os motivos da solicitação de exclusão.

● Atuar de maneira proativa na tentativa de retenção, oferecendo soluções adequadas como ajustes de limites, pausas temporárias ou encaminhamento a áreas especializadas.

● Explicar de forma escrita, clara e objetiva os impactos da exclusão, apresentando alternativas viáveis.

● Garantir comunicação cordial, empática e profissional, adaptada ao tom de texto.

● Quando a exclusão for mantida, orientar o cliente sobre o procedimento correto na plataforma.

● Registrar com precisão todos os atendimentos, incluindo os motivos de exclusão e tentativas de retenção.

● Reportar insights e feedbacks recorrentes para contribuir com a melhoria contínua da experiência do cliente.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

● Ensino médio completo ou em andamento.

● Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em canais digitais (chat, e-mail, redes sociais).

● Excelente comunicação escrita, com domínio da norma culta da língua portuguesa.

● Habilidade de negociação e persuasão para retenção de clientes.

● Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos.

● Conhecimento básico de sistemas de atendimento (Zendesk, CRM, chats).


Diferenciais:

● Vivência com plataformas como Zendesk, Jira e Slack.

● Experiência em retenção de clientes ou em processos de cancelamento.

● Conhecimento em comunicação assertiva e atendimento humanizado.

● Familiaridade com sistemas de atendimento e CRM.


Benefícios:

  • Vale-alimentação
  • Auxílio home office

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.


  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.


Competências


  • Capacidade de planejar e conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.


  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.


Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.


Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.


Ambiente de Trabalho: Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Gerente de logística de transporte
description:
Principais Atividades:

• Planejamento e controle de fretes para transporte de grãos e adubo

• Contato com motoristas e transportadoras

• Fechar contratos

• Contato com motoristas e transportadoras

• Emissão de documentos de transporte (CT-e, MDF-e, etc.)

• Acompanhamento de carregamentos, roteiros e entregas

• Controle de prazos, pesagens, notas fiscais e comprovantes

• Resolução de ocorrências de transporte e suporte ao time operacional

• Atualização de planilhas e sistemas logísticos

Conhecimento em processos de BID (cotação eletrônica de fretes/negociação com transportadoras);

Habilidade em análise de custos e indicadores logísticos;


Requisitos:

• Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em Logística, Administração, ou áreas afins)

• Experiência com logística de fretes

• Conhecimento em emissão de CT-e, MDF-e e documentos fiscais

• Domínio básico de Excel e sistemas de gestão logística

• Organização, agilidade e boa comunicação

title: BD(Recruited Agencies)
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
What You’ll Do

As part of our talent acquisition team, you are charged with finding top talent. You’re responsible for guiding candidates through our recruiting process and partnering with hiring leaders to help build their teams. You are enthusiastic and driven, which allows you to develop meaning relationships. You are systems savvy and passionate about improving our recruiting process.


We are looking for a Recruiter with experience identifying top talent for niche positions across different verticals. The ideal candidate demonstrates their expertise by sharing recruiting best practices, engaging highly skilled talent while setting time to fill expectations based on data. He/she is organized, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is a strong communicator.


Please submit your resume in English. Applications in other languages cannot be considered.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Partner with Hiring Leaders to develop a complete understanding of each opening.
  • Manage the entire recruiting life cycle from candidate generation through direct sourcing, interviewing, salary negotiations, job file maintenance, offer extension and closing candidates.
  • Identify passive candidates using intricate Boolean searches, user groups, professional and social networking, candidate referrals, networking, and our ATS
  • Be passionate about social media and savvy internet research
  • Pipeline candidates and identify what future opportunities they may be a fit for
  • Focus & lead on Diversity identification, sourcing, and attraction
  • Proactively research and generate new/creative sourcing ideas for filling challenging positions by using knowledge of current sourcing practices and trends
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with candidates and hiring leaders throughout the recruiting lifecycle


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Approximately 6+ years of proven experience as a technical recruiter, with a strong track record of sourcing and closing talent in engineering and product roles.
  • In-house recruiting experience, ideally within tech/SaaS environments
  • Proven track record managing full-cycle recruitment: kick-off calls, job postings, sourcing, screening, assessments, interview coordination, and offer management
  • Excellent written and spoken English
